//: These three packages are listed. Each sets GenerateDocumentationFile, so DocFX reads the XML
TargetFramework is pinned because the projects multi-target. Without pinning, DocFX builds every
target and emits duplicate members. It is net8.0, the one target that all three have:
MorseCode.Avalonia.Controls targets net8.0 and net10.0, as Avalonia 12 does, and references
MorseCode.Mvvm. DocFX must see the same target for a project and for the reference to it. When
the Controls entry was separate and pinned to net8.0 while Mvvm had no such target, DocFX
reported that it found a project reference without a matching metadata reference.
template lists the overrides last, because docfx applies them in order: 'template' is this
repository's folder, and its public/main.css and public/main.js replace the empty files of
the same names that 'modern' supplies for exactly this purpose.
